entity_types.name: Politician
entity_types.description: Elected or appointed political leaders in Thailand or Cambodia who shape national policy.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the politician

attributes.name: political_rank
attributes.description: The current office held, such as Prime Minister or MP

attributes.name: party_affiliation
attributes.description: The political party the individual belongs to

entity_types.name: Diplomat
entity_types.description: Officials representing their country in foreign relations and international negotiations.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the diplomat

attributes.name: assigned_country
attributes.description: The country where the diplomat is currently posted

attributes.name: diplomatic_rank
attributes.description: The official title like Ambassador or Consul General

entity_types.name: MilitaryOfficer
entity_types.description: High-ranking members of the armed forces involved in border security and domestic stability.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the officer

attributes.name: military_branch
attributes.description: The branch of service, e.g., Royal Thai Army

attributes.name: rank_title
attributes.description: The military rank held by the individual

entity_types.name: PoliticalParty
entity_types.description: Organized groups that seek to influence government policy and contest elections.

attributes.name: party_name
attributes.description: The official name of the political party

attributes.name: ideology
attributes.description: The primary political stance of the party

attributes.name: leader_name
attributes.description: The current leader of the party

entity_types.name: GovernmentAgency
entity_types.description: State departments responsible for specific areas of administration and foreign policy.

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: The full name of the government department

attributes.name: jurisdiction_area
attributes.description: The specific sector managed, e.g., Foreign Affairs

attributes.name: head_official
attributes.description: The person currently leading the agency

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: News organizations and digital platforms that report on political events and frictions.

attributes.name: outlet_name
attributes.description: The name of the news organization

attributes.name: media_type
attributes.description: The format of the media, e.g., Digital News, TV

attributes.name: editorial_bias
attributes.description: The perceived political leaning of the outlet

entity_types.name: PoliticalActivist
entity_types.description: Individuals or group leaders who campaign for political change or nationalistic causes.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the activist or movement leader

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: The primary political or social issue they advocate for

attributes.name: movement_name
attributes.description: The name of the group or movement they represent

entity_types.name: AcademicExpert
entity_types.description: Scholars and researchers who provide analysis on geopolitics and regional frictions.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the scholar

attributes.name: field_of_expertise
attributes.description: The specific area of study, e.g., Southeast Asian Politics

attributes.name: institution_name
attributes.description: The university or think tank they are affiliated with

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any natural person not covered by specific categories.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual

attributes.name: bio_description
attributes.description: A short biography or social media description

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: The city or region where the person is based

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any group or entity not covered by specific categories.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization

attributes.name: mission_statement
attributes.description: The primary goal or purpose of the organization

attributes.name: headquarters_location
attributes.description: The physical location of the main office

edge_types.name: CRITICIZES
edge_types.description: Publicly expresses disapproval of another entity's actions or policies.

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Engages in formal discussions to resolve frictions or reach agreements.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Provides news coverage or analysis regarding an entity's activities.

edge_types.name: ALLIED_WITH
edge_types.description: Forms a political or strategic partnership with another entity.

edge_types.name: ADVISES
edge_types.description: Provides expert recommendations or guidance to a decision-maker.

edge_types.name: PROTESTS_AGAINST
edge_types.description: Organizes or participates in public demonstrations against an entity.

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Shapes the opinions or behaviors of another entity through communication.

edge_types.name: MEMBER_OF
edge_types.description: Indicates formal membership or employment within an organization.

analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex geopolitical relationship between Thailand and Cambodia. It focuses on the primary actors capable of social media interaction, including political leaders, diplomats, and military officers who manage border frictions. It also includes media outlets and activists who drive public opinion, and academics who provide the geopolitical context. Fallback types ensure all social media participants can be categorized.
